name: Sigil of the Tyrant
body:
School necromancy; Level bloodlord 4, cleric/oracle 4, druid 4, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4, summoner 3, witch 4; Autarky

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components V, S, M (blood from a lemming used to draw the sigil)

EFFECT

Range personal and close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 caster levels); see text
Target you
Duration 1 hour/level

DESCRIPTION

As part of casting this spell, you use blood drawn from a lemming to paint on your forehead the personal sigil of a mysterious summoner known only as Tyrant. For the duration of this spell, you draw in fragments of the essence of your summoned creatures to collect and form a boon you can bestow upon target creatures.

During this spell’s duration, whenever one of your summoned creatures within close range of you is killed, the sigil of the Tyrant absorbs a fragment of the summoning magic, generating 1 rune fragment. Each time the sigil of the Tyrant has collected 4 rune fragments, the 4 rune fragments fuse to form 1 tyrannical runemark (which is then stored into the sigil). For the purposes of this spell, only your summoned creatures from spells you have personally cast counts towards generating a rune fragment (summoned creatures via spell-like abilities, supernatural abilities, class features, magic items, and other sources do not count).

As a swift action, you can bestow 1 tyrannical runemark upon a target creature within close range. A tyrannical runemark confers the target creature a +1 dodge bonus to AC and a +1 luck bonus to attack and damage rolls with melee weapons (including thrown melee weapons, unarmed strike, and natural attacks).

The benefits of a tyrannical runemark, once bestowed upon a target creature, lasts for a number of rounds equal to 1 round/5 caster levels you possess. A creature can only gain the benefit of up to 5 tyrannical runemarks. You can only designate 1 target creature for any given tyrannical runemark.

Alternatively, you may spend a full-round action to bestow all of the tyrannical runemarks your sigil of the Tyrant currently holds upon target creatures within close range.
